transcript.content: Hello. What brings you to the clinic today?

For the past six months, I’ve been dealing with this overwhelming surge of energy where I feel constantly hyperactive and just can't seem to slow down. My mood has also been all over the place, swinging wildly from feeling extremely happy and on top of the world to getting incredibly irritated over the smallest things. It's just been really intense trying to manage these constant highs and sudden bursts of anger.
During these periods of high energy, have you ever experienced things like hearing voices, seeing things others couldn't, or holding beliefs that others found highly unusual?

Yes, actually, during those exact times when my energy is through the roof, I've heard voices and seen things that other people couldn't see. I also felt completely convinced that I had a special power and a unique mission to accomplish. It only seems to happen when I'm in those high-energy states.

latest_inference.note: Previously, the candidates included Bipolar I Disorder, Bipolar II Disorder, Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features, and Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type). The patient has confirmed experiencing manic symptoms (high energy, grandiosity, irritability) accompanied by psychotic features (hallucinations and delusions). Because these psychotic symptoms occur exclusively during the manic episodes, Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type) is ruled out (as it requires psychotic symptoms to persist for at least 2 weeks in the absence of mood symptoms). Bipolar II is also ruled out because the presence of psychotic features automatically classifies the episode as manic rather than hypomanic. Therefore, the diagnosis is narrowed down to Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features.
